_comment: Quasar finale (ADR 013 issue 5) — the two POST /api/v1/scenes/{id}/push envelopes. LEGACY single-blueprint shape (compiler.PushEnvelope): canvas_version is the sha256 64-hex layout hash served by ZabCanvas (NOT a literal); blue_blueprint_id is the Blue blueprint UUID (NOT the slug). Both scenes push with the SAME canvas_version — the rule never goes on air so its rendered layout is immaterial; reusing the one stored finale bundle keeps the push valid. See docs/runbooks/quasar-finale-stream-level-reactive.md §2-§4 for the UUIDs and the validate/activate/promote sequence.

reactive_scene_push.role: ACTIVATED — the antenna; on-event(stream_chat_event) repaints chat.display

stream_rule_push.role: PROMOTED via POST /api/v1/show/stream-rules — always-on; 14 on-platform-event spines → show.emit
